blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A lawmaker has called out water concessionaire Maynilad Water Services Inc. for the company’s allegedly poor service, noting that they mention a lot of reasons while still earning billions annually. In a statement on Thursday, Las Piñas Rep. Mark Anthony Santos said that consumers cannot be satisfied by Maynilad’s habit of pointing to the northeast monsoon season and the poor water quality of Laguna Lake as the reasons behind low water supply. Santos said this after the House of Representatives committee on public works and highways’ discussed his House Resolution (HR) No. 864, which called for an investigation […]...
